stops.name: Naturpark Kamptal-Schönberg
stops.detail: You will also find the Grüner Veltliner here, the grape variety most frequently grown in Lower Austria. On the meadows in the Kamptal-Schönberg Nature Park, for example, the Schopfige grape hyacinthe thrives, which is highly endangered in the northern pre-Alpine region. However, it can only be found early in the year, because it is an onion plant that retreats completely into the soil until the summer.
